description: Run better sprint retrospectives — pick a format (Start/Stop/Continue, 4Ls, Sailboat, Mad/Sad/Glad, Starfish) and get guided question prompts.

faqs.a: Start/Stop/Continue, the 4Ls (Liked, Learned, Lacked, Longed for), Sailboat, Mad/Sad/Glad, and Starfish — each with its own prompt set.
Each format ships with 4–6 facilitator questions you can read out or paste into your retro board.
faqs.q: What do I get per format?

faqs.a: Yes — copy the whole prompt set with one click.

howto: Copy them into your retro board.
title: Sprint Retro Ideas
